testsuite.name: Karoz - Course, Resource & Timetable Management (Iteration 3 UC1, Iteration 4 UC-S4-005)
testsuite.details:
Tester: Karoz
Software under test: UniShare (github.com/Seganation/unishare)
Test basis: UniShare_Iteration_3.md Use Case 1 (UC-S3-001) and UniShare_Iteration_4.md UC-S4-005, and the code that implements them: tRPC routers course.ts, resource.ts, timetable.ts; src/components/courses/course-form.tsx, src/components/resources/*, src/components/timetable/*, src/app/(student)/courses/*, src/app/(student)/timetable/page.tsx, src/app/api/uploadthing/core.ts, src/app/api/cron/class-reminders/route.ts, middleware.ts.
Techniques: Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Decision Table (DT), State Transition (ST), Use Case / scenario testing (UC), Error Guessing (EG).

Common test data (prisma/seed.ts, all seeded passwords are admin123)
Student A - Sarah Ahmed (sarah@student.utm.my), APPROVED, Faculty of Computing. Owns "Data Structures & Algorithms" (John = accepted CONTRIBUTOR) and "Web Development"; accepted VIEWER of "Machine Learning" (owner John); favourites: Data Structures & Algorithms, Web Development, Machine Learning; default timetable "Fall 2024 Schedule" (John = accepted VIEWER, David = PENDING).
Student B - John Doe (john@student.utm.my), APPROVED. Owns "Machine Learning" and "Database Systems"; own timetable "Fall 2024 Schedule" on which Sarah is an accepted CONTRIBUTOR and Lisa has a PENDING invitation.
Student C - Michael Chen (michael@student.utm.my), APPROVED, Faculty of Engineering, no access to Sarah's courses.
Student D - Alice Wong (alice@student.utm.my), role PENDING (not approved).
Other approved students: David Kim, Lisa Martinez, Emily Rodriguez.
Fresh data used in the cases (created by the tester): course "SECJ3343 Software Quality Assurance" owned by Sarah; empty timetable "SQA Week" owned by Sarah; course colours = the 8 swatches of src/lib/course-colors.ts (Purple #a855f7, Blue #3b82f6, Green #10b981, Orange #f97316, Red #ef4444, Pink #ec4899, Teal #14b8a6, Indigo #6366f1).
API checks can be done with the browser DevTools console or a tRPC client logged in as the stated student (procedures course.*, resource.*, timetable.*).
